wayback._note: Eras are added once the archive answers: the Internet Archive was in a machine-wide cooldown at kickoff (shared_throttle ia.cooldown, until about 02:05 UTC 2026-09-27), so no CDX query was possible when this file was written. The live site already carries the historical book (292 of 856 listed companies read 'Prior Investment'), so the archive's job here is dating listings and recovering delisted rows, not enumeration.

roster._note: The live team page mixes four kinds of people: Investors (140), Onsite Experts (52, the operating team), Firm Operations and Capital Partnerships (27), and Advisors (the CIO Council and Government Advisory Board, 68 outside executives who hold no seat for the firm). Only the Investors department feeds the Form D sweep. The provisional roster is built from the live Investors department, the Investment Team names on the 856 company panels and the related persons on the firm's own fund Form Ds (scratch/build-roster.py); archived people pages are unioned in after the archive cooldown.

sources._note: The live portfolio: every sfcompany post (856), each read through the site's own insight/v1 panel endpoint (scratch/pull-site-insight.py). 'initial_investment' is the firm's own month and year of first investment; invest_year and invest_date are parsed from it. 'site_status' is the FIRM's position (Current Investment / Prior Investment), never the company's state. The panel publishes no round word, so there is no entry_stage_fields entry; the case-study text on the few panels that carry one ('investment_journey') names a round in words and is read by the judge.

site_api._note: insightpartners.com is WordPress with a theme REST namespace, insight/v1, that feeds the Vue portfolio and team grids; wp/v2 serves the post types sfcompany (856) and sfuser (288) and the Ideas archive (about 1,665 posts). Every route is public and is what the site's own pages call.

edgar._note: Entity-qualified phrases only. The bare phrase 'Insight Partners' is shared by unrelated registrants (Capital Insight Partners, Insight Wealth Partners, Insight Investment), so the full-text sweep runs on the vehicle families. 'Insight Equity' (I to III, Mezzanine, Holdings; Southlake, Texas) is an unrelated private-equity firm and is classified external.
edgar._thirteenf_note: Insight Holdings Group, LLC (CIK 1305473, the home address) files the firm's 13F-HR; Insight Venture Management, LLC (CIK 1498545) files 13F-NT notices pointing to it. The layer never seeds membership (T3): it corroborates a public status, dates the first public quarter, and lists the issuers the recall probe checks for a pre-IPO round.

desks._note: One registered adviser, Insight Venture Management, LLC (CRD 142994, SEC 801-67560), 1114 Avenue of the Americas, 36th Floor, New York; no relying adviser and no brand-sharing registration (decisions.md D1). The public-equities vehicles (Insight Partners Public Equities, IPPE) are a non-venture strategy of the same adviser and partition as 'public' (T1 strategy desks). The buyout-named vehicles (Growth-Buyout Coinvestment Fund, XII Buyout Annex Fund, XIII Growth Buyout Fund) invest beside the flagship funds, which hold control positions themselves, so they stay on the home desk and control is decided per transaction (decisions.md D2, D3). External: the Insight Equity family (an unrelated Texas firm), the Access and iCapital feeders (third-party feeders, the Thrive IX Access precedent). Desks resolve by CIK and filing address, never by the name pattern alone. Co-filer vehicles with no fund name resolve by filing address (COLLECTION.md 5.3): Insight Capital Partners III and its Cayman and co-investor parallels (the firm's Fund III, filing from 527 Madison Avenue and 680 Fifth Avenue, its earlier offices), Insight-Salmon River LLC (680 Fifth Avenue, 8th floor), and the holding vehicles Grace Software Cross Fund Holdings, Insight E2open Aggregator, Insight Falcon, Insight Satellite Co-Invest, Insight SN Holdings, Shutterstock Investors and Star Trinity (all 1114 Avenue of the Americas or care of Insight) are home-desk vehicles. Salmon River Capital (S. Joshua Lewis's firm, which shared the 680 Fifth Avenue floor) and Scott Maxwell (a partner until 2006, then OpenView) stay external.

profile.own_vehicle_pattern: ^(insight venture (partners|associates|management)|insight partners|insight associates|insight holdings group|insight vision capital|ivp cif|ippe )
profile._note: Insight's own sector filter has 29 values. focus_min_companies is provisional at kickoff (about 4.5% of the expected base) and restated once the base lands.

shape._note: The 0.80 default stands. Insight enters at growth rounds by design, so the Seed cohort is expected to be small; a breach on a small cohort is ruled at close on the measured cohort. There is no ceiling on the $1B+ share (Erik, 2026-09-26).
